## Summary
A look in a meeting set off "she thinks I'm useless", shame and a racing heart, and I went quiet. Checking what I saw moved the belief from 80 to 45.

## Notes
- 18:02 Mood 4 of 10. Safety screen asked directly: no thoughts of harming self or others.
- 18:09 Noted one moment of two; straight into the next meeting each time.
- 18:21 Mapped Thursday's meeting with the five-part model.
- 18:34 Belief in the thought went from 80 to 45.

## Practice task for next time
One moment in three columns, straight after stand-up.
